comment: Tool registry for the tool-call eval (scripts/eval_toolcall.py). Each eval item shows a SUBSET of these (its `tools` list + the always-shown get_time/clarify/none) so the prompt fits block_size 1024 on the 350M. `clarify` and `none` are answer markers, not real tools: `clarify` = a required argument is missing from the request; `none` = no listed tool can satisfy it.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Current weather conditions for a city

tools.description: Weather forecast for a city over the coming days
